recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed unless the work group wants a new enhancement beyond the applied FHIR-13440 request.
issue_request: FHIR-13440 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking for tooling to view a resource maturity dependency graph so dependent resource maturity could be considered when assessing a resource.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 12693. Git history maps that to commit 323620c9c14b0a10f24e9b1429b91c9016a69f90, which added source/template-dependencies.html and linked resource pages to a dependency analysis page. The same commit also made unrelated value set/code system ballot status changes.
additional_context: The dependency template moved from source/ to tools/templates/ in 2020 and remains present. Current resource templates still link active resources to dependency analysis pages, source/history.html records "Add dependency analysis" for the R4 draft stream, and build.fhir.org currently renders a Patient dependency analysis link and maturity dependency graph. Community searches found only Jira/Zulip bot notifications and no Confluence or human Zulip discussion changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope source and rendered CI build already provide the maturity dependency viewer requested by FHIR-13440.
